in_chain_replicate.role: the within-chain null (registered by the coordinator)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: NO-HARM ADMITTED: against the knowledge wave's SHARED in-chain A/A SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WAVE1-AA-FOLD-A-V1 flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (PRIMARY -- the mechanism acts on slots, so owner decision 133's intent-primary rule, scoped to intent-acting mechanisms, does not apply and decision 115's shape holds) is not below -1.2485 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (the guard) is not below -0.9943 pp -- each at its own Fold A own-null half-width (docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). A SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound above zero is REPORTED as a development-fold effect beside the no-harm verdict, never as an admission of benefit (the design's benefit floor is 2.5 pp and the measured analogue sits below it). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the per-type FN/FP table on the 19 revised types, the realised prompt-token delta per Solver/Reviewer/Planner contact and per row, and the K2/K3/K4 item classes of registered-facts-v1.json read on the sealed arm.
steps: 1. Refuse unless the W4 arm and the shared A/A each carry a COMPLETE sealed 1,080-row manifest with one successful complete official TRAIN score and this package's / the A/A package's config hashes.

2. Structural stage: every W4 request carries the slot-contracts-w4-v1 snapshot identity; realised prompt tokens per Solver/Reviewer/Planner contact, arm minus A/A, against the registered token_cost; count of compacted contacts on each arm (expected 0).
3. Score once per arm with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch, never sharded.

4. Paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260927) of arm minus shared A/A on official pooled SLU-F1 (primary) and intent accuracy (guard); the same delta against the sealed AGREE arm BESIDE it, never instead.

5. Apply the rule: ADMITTED (no harm) iff SLU lower bound >= -1.2485 and intent lower bound >= -0.9943; HARMFUL iff either upper bound < 0; otherwise NOT ADMITTED (width). A SLU lower bound above zero is reported as a development-fold effect, never as an admitted benefit.

6. Mechanism read (model-free, counts only): per revised type FN/FP arm vs A/A; the registered K2 / K3 / K4 item classes (registered-facts-v1.json fold_a_offline) re-read on the sealed arm -- converted, unchanged, broken -- and the two risk classes (usually-untagged true positives lost; listed-value over-emissions gained).
7. Report the per-scenario table in both weightings and the frontier row (decision 75).
title: Cell W4 -- the standard paired roster read on SLU (primary) + intent (guard) against the knowledge wave's shared in-chain A/A, sealed AGREE beside it, under the no-harm rule
